description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh: 要删除的精确访问控制规则的名称。
description.en: An array that consists of the names of rules to delete.

title.zh: 删除网站业务精确访问控制规则

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-web-precise-access-rule --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --rule-names testrule --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo DeleteWebPreciseAccessRule --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId default --RuleNames.1 testrule --Domain 'www.aliyun.com'
